d: Short ash-blonde hair with choppy bangs and a side-swept fringe is worn under a black bandana. Sharp, narrow emerald-green eyes set on a youthful, adolescent face with a neutral expression. A slender build features a black triangle bikini top and a black skirt with magenta accents and white trim, worn low on the hips with a magenta garment tied around the waist. Signature details include a black anchor necklace, a black tribal tattoo on the left shoulder, black fingerless gloves, black oxford shoes with magenta trim, and a small black dagger held in the right hand.
